payload.name: The Ancient of Days
payload.note: The divine figure on a fiery throne in Daniel's vision of the beasts; a distinct visionary figure, seen only in Daniel's dream-vision.

stages.label: The Ancient of Days (radiant presence)

quotes.quote: he came even to the Ancient of Days, and they brought him near before him.
until the Ancient of Days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the Most High

stages.text: The Ancient of Days: no human face or body; a presence of white radiance and cloud over a throne of fiery flame, the light pure and unbroken, the glow like white wool and burning fire rising in streams from before him, the seat of judgment set in brilliant cloud under the open sky.

payload.name: Daniel (prophet of Babylon)
payload.note: The Jewish youth taken captive to Babylon, renamed Belteshazzar, who interprets dreams and receives visions; the main entry with many sections in Daniel, distinguished from the prophet named only in Matthew's citation.

stages.label: Daniel (Belteshazzar), prophet of Babylon

quotes.quote: Now among these of the children of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar
he went into his house (now his windows were open in his room toward Jerusalem)

stages.text: Daniel: a lean, dignified Judean man in his youth grown to a grave, graying elder; olive-brown skin; dark hair cropped close and a short trimmed beard flecked with grey; deep-set, steady eyes and a calm, thoughtful face. Signature outfit: a long undyed linen tunic under a plain indigo wool cloak with a blue fringed hem. Props: a small leather scroll case slung at the hip.

aliases: one like a son of man
payload.name: One like a son of man
payload.note: The figure coming with the clouds of heaven to receive dominion in Daniel's vision; not the Gospel Jesus, but a distinct heavenly figure in Daniel.

stages.label: One like a son of man

quotes.quote: there came with the clouds of the sky one like a son of man, and he came even to the Ancient of Days

stages.text: One like a son of man: a man in his prime, early thirties, of athletic but dignified build; skin warm olive-brown; short dark hair and a close-cut beard; calm, steady features with a grave, luminous gaze. He wears a long white linen tunic with a deep blue-purple cloak falling from the shoulders, edged with gold thread. He carries no props.

payload.name: Babylon
payload.note: The city and empire of exile and captivity across the prophets, histories and psalms, also called Babylonia, Shinar and the land of the Chaldeans; the same place in every division.

stages.label: Babylon

quotes.quote: The wide walls of Babylon will be utterly overthrown. Her high gates will be burned with fire.
I will execute judgment on Bel in Babylon, and I will bring out of his mouth that which he has swallowed up.
He brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.
I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me.

stages.text: Babylon: a vast walled city of baked brick on a flat plain watered by broad canals and rivers, its wide walls rising high and its great gates of bronze-banded cedar. Date palms and reed beds line the riverbanks, and ziggurat towers and palace roofs of brick rise above the flat skyline, with the temple of Bel among them.

payload.name: Elisha son of Shaphat
payload.note: Prophet, Elijah's successor, who first appears as a farmer plowing with twelve yoke of oxen in 1 Kings and is later named in 2 Kings and Luke; the same prophet in all three entries.

stages.label: Elisha son of Shaphat

quotes.quote: found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him
Elijah went over to him and put his mantle on him.
He took Elijah’s mantle that fell from him
He went up from there to Bethel. As he was going up by the way, some youths came out of the city and mocked him, and said to him, “Go up, you baldy! Go up, you baldy!”

stages.text: Elisha son of Shaphat: a man in his middle years, broad-shouldered and sun-browned from working the fields, lean and steady in build. Dark skin, a bald head, and a close-cut beard with some grey at the chin. Calm, weathered face with deep-set eyes. Signature outfit: a plain undyed linen tunic belted at the waist with a cloak of rough brown wool. Signature prop: Elijah's mantle, a dark sheepskin cloak he wears over his shoulders.

payload.action: Thrones are being set in place as the seat of judgment settles under the open sky; flames curl slowly outward from the seat while Daniel lifts his eyes and stands still in awe.
payload.composition: Wide view from below, seat and radiance rising high at center, Daniel small in the lower foreground looking up, wheels and cloud spreading across the frame.
payload.mood: Reverent, awe-struck and solemn, with a quiet expectation of judgment.
payload.primarySubject: Pure white radiance and cloud gathered over an unoccupied seat of fiery flame, the seat of judgment, with wheels of burning fire beneath it; Daniel stands at a distance below, gazing upward.
payload.secondaryElements: Wheels of burning fire rolling beneath the fiery seat; streams of white radiance pouring like wool across the cloud; Daniel in a simple Babylonian tunic and cloak at the lower edge.
payload.setting: Vast open heavenly expanse of drifting cloud and radiant fire above Babylon, no ground in sight except the dim distant city glow below.
payload.timeOfDay: Night vision under an unbroken sky of darkness, lit only by the fiery glow of throne and wheels.

canon.name: The Ancient of Days
canon.text: The Ancient of Days: no human face or body; a presence of white radiance and cloud over a throne of fiery flame, the light pure and unbroken, the glow like white wool and burning fire rising in streams from before him, the seat of judgment set in brilliant cloud under the open sky.

canon.name: Daniel (prophet of Babylon)
canon.text: Daniel: a lean, dignified Judean man in his youth grown to a grave, graying elder; olive-brown skin; dark hair cropped close and a short trimmed beard flecked with grey; deep-set, steady eyes and a calm, thoughtful face. Signature outfit: a long undyed linen tunic under a plain indigo wool cloak with a blue fringed hem. Props: a small leather scroll case slung at the hip.
